Name: Jeroboam II, King of Israel
Summary: Jeroboam the second, son of Jehoash, reigned forty-one years and restored Israel's border from Hamath to the Sea of the plain, according to the word of Jonah, though he did not depart from Jeroboam's sins.
RelatedPeople: Jehoash, King of Israel; Jonah; Zachariah, King of Israel; Amos; Hosea
LifeLesson: Prosperity is not approval: Jeroboam II's victories came with Jeroboam I's sins intact.
